g.text: give the task to the environment
and the checks of the project
the change is the new environment
call the tools of the kernel
The live state of Emacs is read
does the task need a child?
The preset is a file: a name, a model,
the child runs in a session of its own,
with its own journal, its own tools
The depth of the tree is bounded,
the time of a child is bounded,
the budget of a child is bounded
the child changes the environment too
the agent keeps the tools of its own
run the check of the environment
the agent fixed its own code
